name: Bitwarden-Portal
description: Automate backup and restore between Bitwarden and/or Vaultwarden vault.

variables.name: Backup Cron Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for backup and restore tasks

variables.name: Encryption Password
variables.description: This is the password used to encrypt and decrypt the backup files during the sync process.

variables.name: Source - URL
variables.description: The URL of the source Bitwarden/Vaultwarden server.

variables.name: Source - Username
variables.description: The username of the source Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account.

variables.name: Source - Password
variables.description: The password of the source Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account.

variables.name: Source - Client ID
variables.description: The client ID of the source Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account, found in Account Settings -> Security -> Keys

variables.name: Source - Client Secret
variables.description: The client secret of the source Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account, found in Account Settings -> Security -> Keys

variables.name: Destination - URL
variables.description: The URL of the destination Bitwarden/Vaultwarden server.

variables.name: Destination - Username
variables.description: The username of the destination Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account.

variables.name: Destination - Password
variables.description: The password of the destination Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account.

variables.name: Destination - Client ID
variables.description: The client ID of the destination Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account, found in Account Settings -> Security -> Keys

variables.name: Destination - Client Secret
variables.description: The client secret of the destination Bitwarden/Vaultwarden account, found in Account Settings -> Security -> Keys

variables.name: Retention Days
variables.description: Retention policy for backup files. Backups older than this value will be deleted.

variables.name: Minimum File Count
variables.description: If all backups are older than the retention day setting, keep the following minimum files.
